AgeGroup_age_bounds.name: AgeGroup_age_bounds
AgeGroup_age_bounds.value: ("minAge" IS NULL OR "minAge" >= 0) AND ("maxAge" IS NULL OR "maxAge" >= 0) AND ("minAge" IS NULL OR "maxAge" IS NULL OR "minAge" <= "maxAge")

CoachAssignment_has_target.name: CoachAssignment_has_target
CoachAssignment_has_target.value: "studentMemberId" IS NOT NULL OR "ageGroupId" IS NOT NULL

MembershipPlan_credits_match_kind.name: MembershipPlan_credits_match_kind
MembershipPlan_credits_match_kind.value: ("kind" = 'CREDITS' AND "creditCount" IS NOT NULL AND "creditCount" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000) OR ("kind" = 'UNLIMITED' AND "creditCount" IS NULL)

CoachProfile_rates_non_negative.name: CoachProfile_rates_non_negative
CoachProfile_rates_non_negative.value: ("privateRateAmount" IS NULL OR "privateRateAmount" >= 0) AND ("groupRateAmount" IS NULL OR "groupRateAmount" >= 0)

CoachProfile_bookable.name: CoachProfile_bookable
CoachProfile_bookable.value: NOT "bookingEnabled" OR ("privateRateAmount" IS NOT NULL AND "sportId" IS NOT NULL)

PaymentTransaction_kind_target.name: PaymentTransaction_kind_target
PaymentTransaction_kind_target.value:
CASE "kind"
        WHEN 'SESSION' THEN num_nonnulls("sessionId", "participantId") = 2 AND num_nonnulls("facilityBookingId", "memberPassId") = 0
        WHEN 'COURT_RENTAL' THEN "facilityBookingId" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("sessionId", "participantId", "memberPassId") = 0
        WHEN 'MEMBERSHIP' THEN "memberPassId" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("sessionId", "participantId", "facilityBookingId") = 0
      END

Subscription_one_live_per_club.name: Subscription_one_live_per_club
Subscription_one_live_per_club.where: "clubId" IS NOT NULL AND "status" NOT IN ('CANCELED', 'INCOMPLETE_EXPIRED')

Subscription_one_live_per_user.name: Subscription_one_live_per_user
Subscription_one_live_per_user.where: "userId" IS NOT NULL AND "status" NOT IN ('CANCELED', 'INCOMPLETE_EXPIRED')

SubscriptionPlan_limits_positive.name: SubscriptionPlan_limits_positive
SubscriptionPlan_limits_positive.value: ("maxFacilities" IS NULL OR "maxFacilities" >= 0) AND ("maxStaff" IS NULL OR "maxStaff" >= 0) AND ("maxAthletes" IS NULL OR "maxAthletes" >= 0)

SubscriptionPlan_paid_has_price.name: SubscriptionPlan_paid_has_price
SubscriptionPlan_paid_has_price.value: "monthlyPriceAmount" = 0 OR "stripePriceId" IS NOT NULL OR NOT "isActive"
